_comment: FROZEN weak-surface inventory (EVALS §3, M1_amb; REVIEW finding E2).
Snapshotted at fixture-authoring time: every weak alias of the eval
watchlist plus every ticker whose lower-cased form was in
data/common_words.txt when the fixtures were written (META, CAT, ALL).
U_amb = {(a,c) : article a contains >=1 of weak_surfaces[c], matched by a
plain case-sensitive whole-token regex scan}. This file is deliberately
NOT derived from data/: editing common_words.txt changes engine behaviour
but must not be able to move a trap out of the hard subset. run.py prints
a report-only diff between this inventory and the live lexicon.
